description.blurb: 216 Kleopatra is a metallic, ham-bone-shaped asteroid approximately 120 kilometers (75 miles) in diameter.
description.more: Kleopatra is a relatively large asteroid, measuring 217 × 94 × 81 km, and has two moons of its own. Calculations from its radar albedo and the orbits of its moons show it to be a rubble pile, a loose amalgam of metal, rock, and 30–50% empty space by volume, likely due to a disruptive impact prior to the impact that created its moons.
